findings.text: During a 12-second window with no user interaction, the page made 30 requests to 7 third-party domains (median of 3 passes).
Of 1.3 MB transferred in that window (compressed responses that finished loading), 629 kB (49%) came from third-party domains, 10 kB of it from services classified as tracking (4 requests).
1 third-party services classified as advertising, analytics, social or audience measurement were contacted before any interaction: dotmetrics.net (Ipsos (Dotmetrics), audience measurement).
